capabilities: Look up selected words and sentences in enabled dictionaries while reading a note
Capture vocabulary with surrounding sentence context into flashcards stored in Markdown
Review cards with a built-in FSRS engine, including audio, daily limits, undo, and pause/resume
Translate captured context automatically via Youdao or enter translations manually
Import legacy SR cards through a migration preview that creates backups
extras: Requires desktop Obsidian 1.14.4 or later. Privacy note: enabled dictionaries receive the selected word or sentence, and optional context translation sends captured paragraphs to Youdao; notes and review data stay in the vault with no remote sync. Review state is stored as append-only events under LinguaLeafData/review/ and users must synchronize the whole data folder and resolve sync conflicts before continuing review. Existing data from the old Language Learner plugin is not automatically migrated.
intentEvidence: This project is derived from Language Learner by the_tree, retains dictionary and Vue panel code
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary lookup or spaced-repetition review for vocabulary captured in place while reading notes.

summary: Vocabulary learning tool that looks up selected words and sentences while reading Markdown and saves them as FSRS-reviewed flashcards.
